meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云成本，减少浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理 Azure 账单并想降低云支出
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud costs to reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Azure bills and want to reduce cloud spending

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询 Azure 历史费用、预测未来支出，并给出优化建议来减少浪费。
howto.when: 当你提到“Azure 费用”、“成本分析”、“如何省钱”等关键词，或要求查看账单、预测支出时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个月的 Azure 费用明细。
say.note: Claude 会查询当前订阅的成本数据。

say.text: 预测下个季度的 Azure 支出。
say.note: Claude 会调用预测 API 给出预估。

say.text: 有哪些 Azure 资源可以优化来省钱？
say.note: Claude 会分析并推荐优化方案。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to query Azure historical costs, forecast future spending, and provide optimization recommendations to reduce waste.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "Azure costs", "cost analysis", "how to save money", or ask to view bills or forecast spending.

say_en.text: Show me the Azure cost breakdown for this month.
say_en.note: Claude queries current subscription cost data.

say_en.text: Forecast Azure spending for next quarter.
say_en.note: Claude calls the forecast API to give an estimate.

say_en.text: What Azure resources can I optimize to save money?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and recommends optimization plans.
